milestones.label: Choquet-Bruhat's existence theorem for the Einstein equations

milestones.label: Christodoulou's nonlinear stability of Minkowski metric
milestones.work: D. Christodoulou, 'The nonlinear stability of the Minkowski metric in general relativity', Lecture Notes in Mathematics, 1989
milestones.description: Christodoulou's announced stability of Minkowski space started the global-existence program for the Einstein equations.

evidence.claim: Lecture Notes in Mathematics chapter with this title exists

milestones.note: The 1989 proceedings chapter is the earliest record found; the full proof appeared later in the 1993 monograph.

milestones.work: D. Christodoulou and S. Klainerman, The Global Nonlinear Stability of the Minkowski Space, Princeton University Press, 1993

milestones.label: Christodoulou's shock formation in 3-dimensional fluids
milestones.work: D. Christodoulou, The Formation of Shocks in 3-Dimensional Fluids, EMS Monographs in Mathematics, 2007
milestones.description: Christodoulou's shock-formation theory for fluids is the analytic method that the shock-formation program for Einstein's equations later extended.

milestones.note: The verified work is the fluid monograph. The Einstein-equation shock program (Christodoulou's later work on gravitational shocks) was not verified bibliographically, so this milestone is about the fluid analogue only.
